_comment: Machine-readable faucet catalog used by script/microwonk/next_faucet_run.py and by Chrome automation. Human guide: docs/FAUCET-RUNBOOK.md

faucets.humanStep: sign in to CDP, pick Base Sepolia, paste address, click Request Funds
faucets.claudeStep: paste address into the address field, click Request, read success banner tx hash
faucets.notes: 0.05 ETH per request. Typically the most reliable source. Requires a CDP project.

faucets.humanStep: sign in to Alchemy; confirm wallet holds >= 0.001 ETH on mainnet; paste address
faucets.claudeStep: paste address, click Send Me ETH, read tx receipt
faucets.notes: 0.1 ETH per request but requires 0.001 ETH on Ethereum mainnet in the connected wallet.

faucets.humanStep: sign in to QuickNode; paste address; solve CAPTCHA
faucets.notes: 0.1 ETH per request when QuickNode has balance. Often dry.

faucets.humanStep: sign in with GitHub; paste address; solve CAPTCHA
faucets.notes: 0.02 ETH per request; useful as a top-up.

faucets.humanStep: sign in; pick Base Sepolia + USDC; paste address; solve CAPTCHA
faucets.claudeStep: select Base Sepolia from network dropdown, select USDC, paste address, click Get tokens
faucets.notes: 10 USDC per address per hour. With 3 docks we can drip 30 USDC/hr => 600 USDC in 20 hours, or 10 hours if all three faucet-cycles run in parallel.

faucets.humanStep: connect wallet that already holds Sepolia ETH (L1); bridge to Base Sepolia
faucets.claudeStep: paste recipient, set amount, click Bridge; user signs in wallet
faucets.notes: Last resort; only useful if you already have L1 Sepolia ETH. Sepolia L1 can be mined via pk910 PoW faucet.

operations.loadingDockStrategy: Register each loading dock address with the accounts a faucet requires. Prefer 3 docks so the three Circle faucet cycles can run in parallel. When any dock has >= 0.005 ETH or >= 10 USDC, run load_treasury.sh to forward to the treasury.
operations.refreshCadence: Re-check faucet rate limits every hour. The advisor (next_faucet_run.py) reports which faucets are eligible now given the per-address-per-day/hour counters in config/faucet-state.json.
operations.stopCondition: Stop once config/microwonk-wallets.json treasury holds >= treasuryMinEthWei and >= treasuryMinUsdcRaw. Verify with check_balances.sh.
